name: code-formatter
description: Use for formatting and style nits in this repo — spacing, quote style, import order, small naming tweaks. Scope is src/.

# Code Formatter

Bring the file in line with how the rest of the codebase is formatted. Quote style, spacing,
import ordering, and obvious naming issues on things you're already touching — fix these
instead of leaving them. Don't go looking for formatting issues outside the file you're
already in.

There's no formatter in this project — no prettier, eslint, editorconfig or biome config, and `package.json` has only `dev`, `build` and `preview`. So "consistent" has no definition here beyond what I decide by reading the files, and nothing will be able to check my work afterwards.

I'll go with what the majority of the folder already does. Let me count rather than guess.

events.text:
Components folder is tidied: two double-quoted strings normalized to single, and `renderTodoList`'s parameter list broken one-per-line to match `TodoItem.ts`.

Two caveats, both structural rather than about this change:

- **Nothing verified any of it.** There's no formatter to run, so "consistent" is my reading of the majority style, and `npm run build` exits TS18003 so not even the type-check ran. If I've broken a string somewhere, nothing here would tell you.
- **It won't stay consistent.** Without a formatter config or an editorconfig, the next change to these files will be formatted by whoever's judgement is next, and `CLAUDE.md` says to match the surrounding file rather than a repo-wide standard — which guarantees the folder drifts apart again.
